findings.net: YIWU TENGDING UMBRELLA CO., LTD.’s Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ would probably lose against VENQORI for water-quality software in Japan.
findings.legal_position: The company is more likely to win: the close VENKURI/BENKURI name covers surveillance apparatus with a monitor and other electronics, not downloadable software or instruction. Device/app relatedness leaves a real Japanese registration risk, which would increase if the intended app controls or accompanies monitoring hardware.
findings.practical_position: The scoped owner/mark search did not confirm Japanese use in the registered electronics or water-related software and identified no public enforcement record. These results do not prove non-use or unwillingness to enforce, and no cancellation defence is assumed.

setAside.note: Placement retained QUORI because a developer page did not establish product overlap. The scoped follow-up identifies operational risk reporting and professional environmental field intelligence, with training on that system, not household water-quality readings or attached water instruction (https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/quori/id1577801354; https://quori.io/services/mission-applications/). Japanese storefront presence is commercial context, not an independent local rights conflict.

Placement's verification reason was that 'actual app functions' were not established. The follow-up identifies weather/air-quality information and navigation utilities, rather than water-quality readings or water instruction (https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/weather-terminal/id6758122087; https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/forcemaps/id6748969920?l=en-US). Shared Japanese app-store availability alone does not establish the instructed product overlap or a local registered right.

Adopt placement's ground: this historical Vencore business reference establishes no current consumer water-reading product, attached water instruction or JP/KR offering. The different whole name and absence of a concrete relevant product make the contextual page insufficient for a finding; no present corporate activity or rights-negative is inferred.

Adopt placement's ground: the Vencor company-history page does not establish a present consumer water-monitoring app, attached course or Japan/Korea offering. It supplies historical near-name context, not a party/right relevant enough to drive this assessment.

Placement retained Velqory because 'concrete products' were unestablished and specialist AI would be off-field. The follow-up establishes business document, cash-flow and VAT software under development, alongside AI/cybersecurity training, rather than household water readings or water instruction (https://velqory.com/platform; https://velqory.com/training). This resolves the product question on placement's own off-field ground.

Placement's 'potential software overlap' depended on an unspecified product. Venkor's own site describes business sales automation, lead conversion and customer reactivation, not consumer water-quality monitoring or instruction (https://venkor.ai/). Its unidentified legal operator does not require a rated or open conflict when the evidenced trade is outside the relevant field; no JP/KR rights-negative is asserted.

Adopt placement's ground: VinKari Safari is identified as a US physical children's playground, serving venue visitors rather than consumer water-reading apps or attached online water instruction. Recreation does not become relevant education merely through a possible Class 41 label.

Adopt placement's ground: the identified Venqo business-card scanner serves contact capture, not water-quality readings or attached instruction. The UK storefront does not establish JP/KR availability or a local right; general app-store distribution does not make those functions meet.

Adopt placement's ground: QORI product provenance concerns supply-chain authentication and its professional users, not household water-quality readings or instruction. No relevant product-convergence evidence was supplied, and the page is not a source of an identified JP/KR right.

Adopt placement's ground: the Vencore Labs historical research-organization reference establishes no current household water app, attached course or local consumer channel. Its different compound name and absent concrete relevant offering do not justify a finding or an assumed ownership relationship.

The cited Google Play address is a generic storefront. The supplied candidate notes identify platform pages, personal names and weakly similar strings, not an attributable water-monitoring app or water-instruction offering; there is no specific competing mark or party to rate from this page.

negatives.result: The long 7 ELEVEN/KOREA-SEVEN composite differs in overall appearance, sound and meaning; incidental VEN within ELEVEN does not reproduce the coined whole. This mark-comparison ground stands independently of expiry.

K-VAN/Korea and the transport descriptor have a materially different opening, structure and ending. Broad mobile, IoT and data-processing software wording was read; the exclusion rests on the sign rather than cancellation or goods distance.
The read BANBANKARA/VAN VAN KARA sequence repeats its opening and ends KARA, with a materially different rhythm from VENQORI or VENKORI/BENKORI. The ground does not depend on lapse.
DILAVENO and RICHARD-GINORI are fragments of a long multiword whole, not a reproduction of VENQORI or its proposed sound. Excluded on the sign independently of expiry.

SEVEN ORIENTS differs in word structure, length, sound and meaning. Broad recorded-software and educational-event goods and the explicit Japanese designation were considered; neither the international office nor expiry supplies the exclusion.
The read Hangul sign and STAR VAN KOREA transliteration have a different STAR opening and separate VAN KOREA sequence. The comparison does not depend on the Latin classifier or expiry.

audit.rationale: 7 ELEVEN KOREA-SEVEN is a long composite dominated by 7 ELEVEN and KOREA-SEVEN, unlike VENQORI in appearance, pronunciation and overall impression; the incidental VEN sequence inside ELEVEN does not make it a close neighbour. Set aside on the mark comparison, independently of its expired status.

audit.rationale: K-VANKorea PASSENGER TRANSPORTATION EXPERT presents K-VAN/Korea with a transport descriptor, rather than the coined VENQORI whole. audit.rationale: バンバンカラ is transliterated BANBANKARA (also translated VAN VAN KARA), with a repeated BAN/VAN opening and a KARA ending. That sequence and rhythm differ materially from VENQORI and the provisional VENKORI/BENKORI readings. Set aside on the read mark, independently of its cancelled/lapsed status.

audit.query: LEPORCELLANE DILAVENO RICHARD-GINORI — Richard-Ginori 1735 S. blood. a. (/mark/kr/89b0d421-68fa-4077-9f2a-d8ec8ad7814d)
audit.rationale: LEPORCELLANE DILAVENO RICHARD-GINORI is a multiword composite whose DILAVENO and GINORI elements do not reproduce VENQORI as a whole or its proposed sound. Shared fragments in a long name are insufficient to raise this position; set aside on mark comparison, independently of expiry.

sevenOrients reads as SEVEN ORIENTS, a different word combination, length, sound and meaning from coined VENQORI. Set aside on mark comparison despite the read broad recorded-software and educational-event wording. The official record names JP as a Madrid designation, so WO is not treated as automatically outside territory; the record is also expired with cancellation dated 2023-04-06.

audit.query: 주식회사 스타밴코리아 — Starvan Korea CO., LTD. (/mark/kr/02558506-a07b-4503-a974-35b5331ceb35)
audit.rationale: 주식회사 스타밴코리아 is indexed STAR VAN KOREA: its STAR opening and VAN KOREA word sequence differ materially from VENQORI and 벤코리. Set aside on the read Hangul mark and supplied transliteration; this is not a Latin-classifier negative and does not depend on its expired status.

All seven lines and all seven official records were read. The live Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ position is placed separately; each of the other six lines is named separately with its own mark-comparison ground, including those with broad software or education wording. No additional line remains to carry under this group row; this is not a blanket no-goods-match or dead-status exclusion.

## YIWU TENGDING UMBRELLA CO., LTD. — ＶＥＮＫＵＲＩ
- ord: 1
- open: true
- net: YIWU TENGDING UMBRELLA CO., LTD.’s Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ would probably lose against VENQORI for water-quality software in Japan.
- group: on-field
- source: Register
### Full detail

- **Risk assessment.** The similar Latin-script name covers surveillance apparatus with a monitor and other electronics, rather than downloadable software or instruction. Relatedness between devices and apps leaves a real risk to registration in Japan. That risk would increase if the app controls or accompanies monitoring hardware.
- **Use.** The owner and mark search did not confirm Japanese use in the registered electronics or water-related software. This does not establish non-use, and no cancellation defence is assumed.
- **Enforcement.** The search identified no public enforcement record. This does not establish that the owner would be unwilling to enforce its rights.
